title: Calculator
summary: Chained operations, careful edge-case handling and automatic light/dark theme.
headline: A calculator that handles the edge cases
intro: A small React Native CLI app to practice clean state management with custom hooks.

sections.title: Features
items: Chained calculations, evaluated left to right
Backspace that safely handles zero, operators and the error state
Division by zero shows an error instead of crashing
Light and dark theme that follows the system

cover.alt: Calculator app in light and dark themes
